title: Deposition of NEDC Matrix using TM Sprayer for High Resolution MALDI Analysis of Metabolites
author: Ali Zahraei
materials: Set the method in the HTX software:
Shut down HTX software and close the computer. Turn off the TM sprayer.
Dispose of syringes in biohazard container.

steps.title: Retrieve and desiccate slides
steps.instruction: Remove slides from the –80 °C freezer and place them in a desiccator for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Acquire autofluorescence image
steps.instruction: Collect an autofluorescence scan of each slide using a Zeiss AxioScan Z1 (protocol link provided).

steps.title: Power on sprayer and set gas flow
steps.instruction: Turn on the TM sprayer and set the nitrogen flow to 10 psi.

steps.title: Set sprayer temperatures for deposition
steps.instruction: Set the nozzle temperature to 55 °C and the heated stage temperature to 30 °C.

steps.title: Clean sample loop with methanol
steps.instruction: With the sprayer set to “load”, flush the sample loop with 3 mL of methanol; then switch to “spray” and allow methanol to spray for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare NEDC matrix solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve NEDC to a final concentration of 14 mg · mL⁻¹ in 90 % methanol; sonicate the solution for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Load matrix into sample loop
steps.instruction: Set the sprayer to “load” and use a syringe to load 2 mL of the matrix solution into the sample loop.

steps.title: Test matrix spray on glass slide
steps.instruction: Switch the sprayer to “spray” and spray for approximately 1 minute; verify spray by placing a clean glass slide under the nozzle.

steps.title: Mount slide and define spray area
steps.instruction: Tape the slide onto the heated stage, then adjust the spray area in the HTX software.

steps.title: Run matrix deposition method
steps.instruction: Highlight the desired method, press **Start** under the Cycle tab, click **Continue**, wait for the purge delay, and confirm that the nozzle is moving.

steps.title: Unload and store slides
steps.instruction: When deposition is finished, remove the slides, place them in a slide box for storage, and press “valve load confirm” in the software.

steps.title: Clean nozzle tip
steps.instruction: Spray the nozzle tip with methanol and acetonitrile (do not let the liquids touch the tip).

steps.title: Reset sprayer temperatures
steps.instruction: Set both the TM sprayer nozzle and the stage temperatures to 30 °C.

steps.title: Flush loop with methanol and spray
steps.instruction: With the sprayer set to “load”, load the loop with 3 mL of methanol; then set the sprayer to “spray” and allow methanol to flow for approximately 5 minutes.

steps.title: Clean stage with methanol‑wet Kimwipes
steps.instruction: Spray methanol onto Kimwipes tissue and wipe the stage clean.
